_what: THE tuning file. Every knob the engine exposes lives here. Edit a value, commit, and the next cycle runs it — no code changes, ever. Missing keys fall back to safe built-in defaults.

arena_grid._what: The authoritative strategy space the arena breeds over. Widen a list and new strategies compete on the next hourly cycle; champions are still elected only by forward survivability on REAL trades.

_note_on_size: 8 drops x 7 targets x 5 stops = 280 MR strategies competing hourly. Sub-percent (0.5%) steps need a naming-scheme upgrade first (names collide at int()); widen here when that ships.

live_output._what: the handoff switch: master|all_quadrants|crypto|stock|metal|energy. enabled stays false until YOU flip it; the engine emits LIVE_ORDERS_PREVIEW.json every cycle either way so the exact orders are visible long before real money.

regime_gate._what: DOWNTREND behavior per book: hard = zero new entries (blocked candidates go to the REGIME_AB proof ledger) · soft = only conviction>=0.5 dips · off = ignore regime

prune._what: monthly data diet — dailies are never touched

regime_overrides._what: per-book per-regime LIVE tuning + participation profiles. 5.1 FINAL: each non-crypto book now runs VOLATILITY-NATIVE thresholds so it actually trades in its own market's rhythm — a 3% dip is a Tuesday in crypto but a monthly event in SPY. stock 0.7-1.5% (Cat 2 trading), metal 0.4-1.0% (Cat 3 gold rhythm), energy 0.8-2.0%. This is the three-categories vision: crypto=aggressive(Cat1), stock=trading(Cat2), metal=investing/rhythm(Cat3).

soft_conviction._what: conviction bar a dip must clear to trade during DOWNTREND when gate=soft

integrity._what: Phase-1 per-step sanity ceilings; symbols beyond them are quarantined from entries AND learning until clean.

warmup._what: pre-entry live-context gate, cadence-proof. June-30 ran 5-min cadence; at degraded 50-66m gaps a fixed high point-count starves entries forever — span is the real safety.

bench_books._what: 5.0 NULL LAYER (Law 10) — four strategy-free $10k baseline books: CASH accrues this APY knob (risk-free hurdle); SPY buy&hold; HODL 50/50 BTC-ETH; EQW equal-weight fresh-crypto basket frozen at creation. Marks from REAL feed samples only; excluded from Master + championship like GEKKO; auto-re-baselines after any WIPE_MARKER. Every governed book is judged as delta-vs-null, never raw P&L alone.

champion_rotation._what: 5.0 — the anti-flip-flop rotation gates, now LIVE-TUNABLE (edit → commit → next cycle). min_trades = forward closed trades a challenger needs; switch_margin = survivability points it must lead by. Defaults preserve 2.18 behavior exactly; lower BOTH to rotate faster as forward evidence lands — the rotation_freshness OBSERVE gate + Research-OS Q002 grade whether faster actually pays. Election runs every cycle, all books.

_broker_policy._what: Alpaca is PRICING-ONLY (operator directive 2026-07-07). Gates ONLY the run_all_harvest_accounts broker call in cli.py — the internal 4-book sim is independent and always runs. Flip true + commit to re-arm.

aggressive_book.name: GEKKO
aggressive_book._what: GEKKO — the aggressive probe book ('greed, for lack of a better word'). 5th independent $10k paper book on the crypto universe: SAME rails (integrity quarantine, knife veto, heatshield floor, fee-honesty), LOWER thresholds. NEVER funded/mirrored by the Master, excluded from champion governance. Chases low-hanging fruit AND manufactures the forward evidence (trade-quality, calibration, fee reality) the governed books need.

exit_policy._what: SELL policy. limit_sell_at_target=true models a resting LIMIT-SELL at each position's own target: it fills the instant price touches the target (a real order type), so a target hit between 10-min cycles is captured, not missed. Exits always use the position's stored target/stop, never the current champion's — a champion rotation never strands an open position with a moved goal. Set false for market-order-only exits.

fingerprint_strategy._what: Per-valuable strategy fitter (5.0). Each mean-reversion candidate is judged by ITS OWN chart: it must have dipped to ~its typical buyable level, it must not be in a genuine multi-day downtrend, and it must reliably recover (min_reliability). Its target is a realistic fraction (realism) of its OWN typical bounce, floored to clear fees — that is what lifts close-rate and win-rate. bounce_h=144 (~1 day) captures slow-market recoveries. trend_override=true lets a name in a strong multi-timeframe uptrend trade through a red book regime. Set enabled=false to revert to the blanket per-book profile.

reentry_cooldown._what: LDO lesson (2026-07-10): a name that just hit its STOP is barred from re-entry for this many minutes, every book incl. GEKKO. 0 disables.

heatshield_autotune._what: 5.1 — the one gate made ACTIONABLE by operator directive: when the measured shield-vs-tight comparison has ≥evidence_min forward trades, the crypto floor uses the MEASURED winner (clamped). mode:'off' restores the constant. Choice is stamped in HEATSHIELD.json; gates board shows WEIGHTED only while genuinely applied.

regime_exit._what: 5.1B crash defense (the July-11 slide lesson). auto: when a book's 15m·30m·1h all read red, HARVEST every open position whose net-now clears fees (REGIME_FLIP_HARVEST, limit-class fill, same cost model). symbol_override_min_conf: a valuable whose own MTF confluence ≥ this may trade through an industry red (max 2/cycle). Every harvest is A/B-logged; CONDUCTOR_REPORT_CARD grades saved% and prints the kill criterion. mode:'off' disables.

stale_capital._what: 5.1B stuck-capital policy: past review_h with head above water → FEE_CLEAR_TIME exit (banks it, frees the capital, never a loss). Underwater past stuck_flag_h → flagged 'stuck' for the report card; heatshield patience still applies (no forced losses).

conviction_sizing._what: 5.1B: wagers scale with earned confidence = 0.45×fingerprint bounce-reliability + 0.35×this book's win-rate on the symbol + 0.20×MTF confluence → 0.5×..2.5× the base fraction, clamped [floor,max] of equity. Flat-base twin logged per trade; SIZING A/B on the report card decides if it stays. mode:'off' = flat sizing.

regime_throttle._what: 5.1B: while the book's fast trio is red, new entries are capped per cycle — never march fresh capital into a confirmed slide.

vol_native._what: 5.11 ACTIVATION: per-name entry = clamp(k·σ1h, class floor, min(class cap, regime base)); σ1h = robust MAD of the name's ACTUAL trailing-1h moves (48h window). Custom-fits EVERY trade to the name's own pulse — quiet markets and quiet INDUSTRIES (the frozen metal/energy books) still surface their own outliers. Never looser than the floor, never demands more than the regime base. mode:'off' restores blanket thresholds. KILL: if vol-native entries lose to fingerprint entries after 60 closed (report card), turn off.

position_caps._what: 5.11 industry law: max TOTAL open positions per book — the anti-lockup governor applied to every industry. A new name must beat a held one for a slot; every cap-skip is logged to actions.

compounder._what: 5.11 WRAP: wager tilt from the confidence card's compounder_score (conf × swing × cadence). KILL via sizing A/B: mode:'off'.
